arxiv-2104-13677.title: Hamiltonian active particles in an environment
arxiv-2104-13677.creator: Timo Eichmann, Diego Fieguth, Daniel Brady, James R. Anglin
arxiv-2104-13677.description: Abstract We examine a Hamiltonian system which represents an active Brownian particle that can move against an external force by drawing energy from an internal depot while immersed in a noisy and dissipative environment. The Hamiltonian consists of two subsystems, one representing the active particle’s motion and the other its depot of ‘fuel’.

arxiv-2108-10885.title: The Uncertain Future of Massive Binaries Obscures the Origin of LIGO/Virgo Sources
arxiv-2108-10885.creator: K. Belczynski, A. Romagnolo, A. Olejak, J. Klencki, D. Chattopadhyay, S. Stevenson, M. Coleman Miller, J.-P. Lasota, Paul A. Crowther
arxiv-2108-10885.description: Abstract The LIGO/Virgo gravitational–wave observatories have detected at least 50 double black hole (BH) coalescences. This sample is large enough to have allowed several recent studies to draw conclusions about the implied branching ratios between isolated binaries versus dense stellar clusters as the origin of double BHs.

arxiv-2204-05035.title: A Bayesian decision support system in energy systems planning
arxiv-2204-05035.creator: Victoria Volodina, Nikki Sonenberg, Peter Challenor, Jim Q. Smith
arxiv-2204-05035.description: Abstract Gaussian Process (GP) emulators are widely used to approximate complex computer model behaviour across the input space. Motivated by the problem of coupling computer models, recently progress has been made in the theory of the analysis of networks of connected GP emulators.

arxiv-2209-08059.title: Backward and non-local problems for the Rayleigh-Stokes equation
arxiv-2209-08059.creator: Ravshan Ashurov
arxiv-2209-08059.description: Abstract Abstract : The Fourier method is used to find conditions on the right-hand side and on the initial data in the Rayleigh-Stokes problem, which ensure the existence and uniqueness of the solution. Then, in the Rayleigh-Stokes problem, instead of the initial condition, consider the non-local condition: u(x,T)=\beta u(x,0)+\varphi(x) , where \beta is either zero or one.

arxiv-2212-13536.title: Universal competitive spectral scaling from the critical non-Hermitian skin effect
arxiv-2212-13536.creator: Fang Qin, Ye Ma, Ruizhe Shen, Ching Hua Lee
arxiv-2212-13536.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Fang Qin, Ye Ma, Ruizhe Shen, Ching Hua Lee. Recently, it was discovered that certain non-Hermitian systems can exhibit qualitative different properties at different system sizes, such as being gapless at small sizes and having topological edge modes at large sizes L L . This dramatic system size sensitivity is known as the critical non-Hermitian skin effect (cNHSE), and occurs due to the competition between two or more non-Hermitian pumping channels.

arxiv-2309-13915.title: Sample Complexity of Neural Policy Mirror Descent for Policy Optimization on Low-Dimensional Manifolds
arxiv-2309-13915.creator: Zhenghao Xu zhenghaoxu@gatech.edu, Xiang Ji xiangj@princeton.edu, Minshuo Chen minshuochen@princeton.edu, Mengdi Wang mengdiw@princeton.edu, Tuo Zhao tourzhao@gatech.edu
arxiv-2309-13915.description: Abstract Policy gradient methods equipped with deep neural networks have achieved great success in solving high-dimensional reinforcement learning (RL) problems. However, current analyses cannot explain why they are resistant to the curse of dimensionality. In this work, we study the sample complexity of the neural policy mirror descent (NPMD) algorithm with deep convolutional neural networks (CNN).

arxiv-2404-08845.title: Enumerating 6D supergravities with 𝑻 ≤ 𝟏 T\leq 1
arxiv-2404-08845.creator: Yuta Hamada, and Gregory J. Loges
arxiv-2404-08845.description: Abstract The space of 6D supergravities with minimal supersymmetry is greatly constrained by anomaly cancellation. Nevertheless, a large number of models satisfy all low-energy consistency conditions and in this work we make progress towards exhaustively enumerating all anomaly-free models with at most one tensor multiplet.

arxiv-2406-03389.title: Hot Schrödinger Cat States
arxiv-2406-03389.creator: Ian Yang, Thomas Agrenius, Vasilisa Usova, Oriol Romero-Isart, Gerhard Kirchmair
arxiv-2406-03389.description: Abstract The observation of quantum phenomena often necessitates sufficiently pure states, a requirement that can be challenging to achieve. In this study, our goal is to prepare a non-classical state originating from a mixed state, utilizing dynamics that preserve the initial low purity of the state.

arxiv-2409-02495.title: CoAst: Validation-Free Contribution Assessment for Federated Learning based on Cross-Round Valuation
arxiv-2409-02495.creator: Hao Wu, Likun Zhang, Shucheng Li, Fengyuan Xu, Sheng Zhong
arxiv-2409-02495.description: Abstract . In the federated learning (FL) process, since the data held by each participant is different, it is necessary to figure out which participant has a higher contribution to the model performance. Effective contribution assessment can help motivate data owners to participate in the FL training.

arxiv-2412-05450.title: Promoting Cooperation in the Public Goods Game using Artificial Intelligent Agents
arxiv-2412-05450.creator: Arend Hintze, Christoph Adami
arxiv-2412-05450.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Arend Hintze, Christoph Adami. The tragedy of the commons illustrates a fundamental social dilemma where individual rational actions lead to collectively undesired outcomes, threatening the sustainability of shared resources. Strategies to escape this dilemma, however, are in short supply. In this study, we explore how artificial intelligence (AI) agents can be leveraged to enhance cooperation in public goods games, moving beyond traditional regulatory approaches to using AI as facilitators of cooperation.

pmc-10551167.creator: Sasja A. Schepers, Sean Phipps, Katie A. Devine, Robert B. Noll, Diane L. Fairclough, Michael J. Dolgin, Kathleen A. Ingman, Nicole M. Schneider, Megan E. Voll, Martha A. Askins, Olle Jane Sahler

pmc-11392239.creator: Wenyi Qiu, Qingjun Mao, Chen Liu
pmc-11392239.description: China’s polyester textile industry is one of the notable contributors to national economy. This paper takes polyester yarn, core raw material in polyester textile industry chain, as research object, and deeply explores its price indicators and risk hedging mechanisms through multiple linear regression models and Holt-Winters approaches.

pmc-11439527.title: A single-center study of patients with rare isolated acquired clotting factor deficiencies other than acquired hemophilia A

Besides acquired factor (F)VIII deficiency (acquired hemophilia A), the remaining factor deficiencies are rare and diverse, posing challenges in both diagnosis and management.

pmc-11525792.creator: Jiacheng Zeng, Jianheng Huang, Jiancheng Zeng, Jiaqi Li, Yaohu Lei, Xin Liu, Huacong Ye, Yang Du, Chenggong Zhang
pmc-11525792.description: For light-element materials, X-ray phase contrast imaging provides better contrast compared to absorption imaging. pmc-11692258.description: From May 13 to 15, 2024, undergraduate nursing students from the U.S. participated in an international exchange at a university in Japan. A one-day program explicitly focused on learning about services for older adults in Japan: this study aimed to evaluate that program.

However, their practical utility is often limited by poor stability, particularly under physiological conditions.

pmc-12729814.creator: Jingbo Pan, Yue Zou, Qi Zhang, Dan Liu

pmc-13291961.title: Valence-State-Dependent Surface Lattice Oxygen in CeO2‑Modified VPO Catalysts: Elucidating the Mechanism of n‑Butane Selective Oxidation to Maleic Anhydride
pmc-13291961.creator: Wenjiao Li, Shupeng Guo, Heqin Guo, Yaqiong Su, Yong Xiao, Minggui Lin, Litao Jia, Debao Li
pmc-13291961.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The selective oxidation of n-butane to maleic anhydride (MA) over the vanadium phosphorus oxide (VPO) catalyst stands as a prominent example of industrial selective alkane functionalization. Despite its commercial maturity, the ambiguous relationship between the catalytic performance and vanadium valence states (Vox) or surface lattice oxygen (OS‑L) persists in generating debate and uncertainty regarding the identity of the active sites in VPO catalysts.

uslaw-usc-t23-s175.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t23-s175.description: United States Code, Title 23 (Highways); Chapter 1 (Federal-Aid Highways). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions.— In this section: (1) Metropolitan planning organization; urbanized area.— The terms “metropolitan planning organization” and “urbanized area” have the meaning given those terms in section 134(b). (2) Transportation emissions.— The term “transportation emissions” means carbon dioxide emissions from on-road highway sources of those emissions within.
